description: Disproved legacy bank retained as a migration tombstone. The former encounter-zone rows duplicate the complete map descriptor table and do not identify an independent encounter structure.
verification_method: All 47 former rows are byte-for-byte the map descriptors at 0x53D910. Runtime map-resource evidence identifies +0x1C as map flags, and code at 0x0806922A consumes byte +0x1D as a flag byte; no independent encounter-zone consumer was found.
notes: Legacy encounter-zone editor rows are diagnostic-only and must not write ROM bytes. Any future random-encounter model requires an independent ROM identity and consumer chain.

_provenance.unattributed_reason: the table's bytes come from the base ROM at offset 5495056 (size 0); the bank records neither a reverse family, a note nor an extracting tool, so no further source is known
